description: Ship particulars by IMO number: name, type, flag, MMSI, call sign, year built, gross tonnage, length and beam, current draught and navigation status from VesselFinder's public page, plus deadweight, builder, engine, owner, manager and class society (when listed) from BalticShipping's public vessel register, with that record's last update date. Owner and class data can be years old. Related tools on this server, for a different need: logistics_sanctioned_vessel_check when you need to search the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals list; logistics_vessel_tracker when you need Live AIS position, speed, heading and voyage status for one. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: logistics_imo_vessel_dossier
title: Ship particulars by IMO number: name, type, flag, MMSI
